messages.subject: Project Drake — your service agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Stephen,

Good to speak earlier. As discussed, Bracken would like you to continue as Managing Director for an initial 12-month term post-completion, on your existing salary plus the agreed retention arrangement. We'll send the service agreement for your review this week; please feel free to take independent advice on it.

Kind regards,
James
